text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder displays incredible<n>skill in a
pre-debut scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The media in attendance compare her<n>to
Maruzensky, a racer known as the<n>"Beast."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder refuses to play<n>second fiddle, and
resolves to<n>overcome her upperclassman.
